title_en: Beautiful Places in China (4/20): Lijiang Old Town, Dusk Under the Lanterns
note_en: 一边…一边… describes two actions done at the same time by the same person, with 一边 in front of each verb: 小舟和木玲一边走一边听着流水声 "Xiao Zhou and Mu Ling walked along, listening to the running water." English uses "while" or an -ing form, but Chinese marks both actions in parallel, as again in 一边散步一边听…纳西族音乐 and 一边诵读象形经书，一边讲述…故事.
